description: Everything played since the game loaded (keys, pointer, param changes) up to `toTick` (default: now), saved as a scenario in .debuff/replays/ that replays it exactly. Use a note's `tick` to reproduce what the human saw when they flagged it, then run_scenarios with the returned file. `warnings` lists anything a replay can't reproduce (for example slow motion).

toTick.description: Last tick to include. Default: the current tick.

name: game_replay
title: Save a replay
